# ABCDE.lv

> Latvian food product browser showing Nutri-Score ratings (A–E) for 18,000+ products from Rimi and Maxima supermarkets. Helps users find healthier food choices using official EU nutritional labelling data. Available in Latvian and English.

## Browse products

- [All products (Latvian)](/lv): Full catalogue sorted by Nutri-Score
- [All products (English)](/en): English version of the full catalogue
- [Rimi products](/lv?store=rimi): Products available at Rimi supermarket
- [Maxima products](/lv?store=maxima): Products available at Maxima supermarket

## Product categories

- [Bread and pastry](/lv/category/maize-un-konditoreja-10): Bread, pastries and bakery products
- [Dairy and eggs](/lv/category/piena-produkti-un-olas-1): Milk, cheese, yoghurt and eggs
- [Drinks](/lv/category/dzerieni-8): Beverages including juices, water and soft drinks
- [For vegans and vegetarians](/lv/category/veganiem-un-vegetariesiem-4): Plant-based and vegetarian products
- [Frozen foods](/lv/category/saldetie-edieni-2): Frozen meals, vegetables and ice cream
- [Fruits and vegetables](/lv/category/augli-un-darzeni-6): Fresh and packaged produce
- [Meat, fish and ready meals](/lv/category/gala-zivis-un-gatava-kulinarija-9): Meat, seafood and prepared dishes
- [Packaged food](/lv/category/iepakota-partika-7): Canned, jarred and shelf-stable groceries
- [Sweets and snacks](/lv/category/saldumi-un-uzkodas-3): Confectionery, chocolate and savoury snacks
